info.name: Shell - Card Transaction Data API (Priced)
info.description:
Shell Card Transaction Data API

This postman collection illustrates the use of api endpoints to search priced transaction data performed by Shell fuel cards.

Pre-requisite Steps

There are only a few steps to get started: 1. Expand the first folder in the collection **1. RUN FIRST - Initialise customer and search data** 2. Click the **Pre-request script** tab for the first request in the folder **1. Get customer payer, colco** 3. Enter either the test or production base url value in the variable `target_url`. For example: `pm.collectionVariables.set("target_url", "https://api-test.shell.com/test");` 4. Enter your Shell api key and secret in the variables `api_key` and `api_secret`. 5. You're ready to go! Click the **Send** button for all the requests in the folder to initialise the default data required for the other API calls. Collection Version: 0.2
